message: `default_discipline {name} {qualifier}: a qualifier is not allowed in Verilog-A
description: In Verilog-AMS, a qualifier after the discipline limits the default to one kind of discrete net. Annex C of the standard excludes discrete nets from Verilog-A, so the qualifier has nothing to apply to.
actions: Write `` `default_discipline {name} `` without the qualifier; it then applies to every net declared without a discipline.
